title: Being Considerate as a Pathway Towards Pluralistic Alignment for Agentic AI
reasoning: The paper investigates 'pluralistic alignment,' which involves ensuring AI behavior is in harmony with diverse human values. It proposes and evaluates a framework where reinforcement learning agents incorporate social welfare functions (such as Rawlsian fairness) and value pluralism into their reward structures. The work includes a qualitative evaluation of how these ethical considerations affect an agent's decision-making in a scenario with conflicting human interests.
